newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Conga resources 120 mln tonnes - Buenaventura.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Conga resources 120 mln tonnes - Buenaventura.

text.p: Peruvian gold and silver miner Cia de Minas Buenaventura SA said Friday its Minas Conga deposit has an estimated 120 million tonnes of mineral resources.

The resources have 1.2 grams of gold per tonne and a 0.4 percent copper content according to results from 38 diamond drill holes spaced 100 metres apart at the deposit, company financial manager Jorge Galvez said in an interview.
Buenaventura hopes drilling about a dozen more holes this year will increase the resources estimate to 8 million ounces, Galvez said.
Minas Conga, which is jointly-owned with Newmont Mining Corp, lies in northern Peru in the same Cajamarca region as the country's largest gold mine Yanacocha -- another Buenaventura-Newmont project.
Analysts believe Minas Conga and the nearby Tanta Huatay deposit, where Buenaventura partners Southern Peru Copper Corp, could develop into mines as large as Yanacocha.
Yanacocha's proven reserves stood at six million ounces last year.
